entries.source: Brazil has roughly 120 million Catholics, the largest Catholic population of any country, and the rosary is an everyday devotional object rather than an occasional gift. But the market is not one uniform demand curve. It is split by price band, by channel, and above all by the feast calendar. A supplier who plans only for “Brazil” will overstock the wrong item; a supplier who plans for Aparecida, Fatima, Carmo and the sacramental seasons will not.
entries.translation: Ang Brazil ay may tinatayang 120 milyong Katoliko, ang pinakamalaking populasyon ng Katoliko sa alinmang bansa, at ang rosaryo ay pang-araw-araw na debosyonal na bagay sa halip na paminsan-minsang regalo. Ngunit ang merkado ay hindi isang pantay na demand curve. Nahahati ito ayon sa price band, sa channel, at higit sa lahat sa kalendaryo ng kapistahan. Ang supplier na nagpaplano lamang para sa “Brazil” ay mag-iimbak ng sobra sa maling item; ang supplier na nagpaplano para sa Aparecida, Fatima, Carmo at mga sakramental na panahon ay hindi.

entries.source: Nobody told Miss Sang to make a rosary. In 2015, she was a young woman living in Yiwu — a city that supplies the world's shelves, yet rarely pauses to ask what the things it makes might mean. She had been drawn to religious objects for years: their weight, their quiet symbolism, the way skilled hands could turn simple materials into something a stranger would hold during the hardest moments of their life.

entries.source: Stainless steel is used for chain, pins, jump rings, crosses, medals, and laser-cut components where durability and corrosion resistance are priorities. Stainless steel is a family of grades, not one material. Grade 304 is widely used; grade 316 contains molybdenum and generally offers stronger resistance in chloride-rich environments. Lower-cost grades may behave differently. Ask for the grade and confirm whether every component is stainless steel or only the main visible part.
entries.translation: Ang stainless steel ay ginagamit para sa kadena, pin, jump ring, krus, medalya, at mga laser-cut na bahagi kung saan ang tibay at paglaban sa kaagnasan ay prayoridad. Ang Grade 304 ay malawakang ginagamit; ang grade 316 ay naglalaman ng molibdenum at karaniwang nag-aalok ng mas malakas na paglaban sa mga kapaligirang mayaman sa chloride. Ang mga mas murang grado ay maaaring kumilos nang iba. Itanong ang grado at kumpirmahin kung ang bawat bahagi ay stainless steel o ang pangunahing nakikitang bahagi lamang.

entries.source: A scapular in the traditional sense is a devotional garment: two small panels of cloth joined by straps and worn over the shoulders. A scapular pendant is a piece of devotional jewellery shaped like a scapular. Both are legitimate products, but they are not interchangeable, and describing one as the other is one of the most common errors in religious goods catalogues.
entries.translation: Ang scapular sa tradisyonal na kahulugan ay isang debosyonal na kasuotan: dalawang maliit na panel ng tela na pinag-uugnay ng mga strap at isinusuot sa mga balikat. Ang scapular pendant ay isang piraso ng debosyonal na alahas na hugis scapular. Pareho silang lehitimong produkto, ngunit hindi sila mapagpapalit, at ang paglalarawan sa isa bilang ang isa pa ay isa sa mga pinakakaraniwang pagkakamali sa mga katalogo ng religious goods.

entries.source: The Brazilian market is served by a mix of local assembly, domestic wholesalers and imports. At the low end, price competition is severe and buyers switch readily. At the middle and upper end, the differentiators are more durable: devotional accuracy, consistent quality between orders, packaging that survives retail and shipping, and the ability to deliver before a fixed feast date.

Sa gitna at mataas na antas, mas matibay ang mga pagkakaiba: katumpakan sa debosyon, pare-parehong kalidad sa pagitan ng mga order, packaging na nakakaligtas sa retail at pagpapadala, at kakayahang makapaghatid bago ang takdang petsa ng kapistahan.

entries.source: A rosary always has the same number of beads, so bead size controls weight, volume and how comfortably it can be held. For children receiving a First Communion rosary, a smaller, lighter bead is easier to hold through a service and less likely to be dropped or tangled. For Confirmation candidates and adult congregations, an adult-size rosary is the safer default.
entries.translation: Ang rosaryo ay laging may parehong bilang ng mga butil, kaya ang laki ng butil ang kumokontrol sa timbang, volume at kung gaano ito kaginhawang hawakan. Para sa mga batang tumatanggap ng First Communion rosary, ang mas maliit at mas magaan na butil ay mas madaling hawakan sa buong serbisyo at mas mababa ang posibilidad na mahulog o magusot. Para sa mga kandidato sa Confirmation at adult congregations, ang adult-size na rosaryo ang mas ligtas na default.

entries.source: Durability also depends on how the rosary is assembled. Nylon and polyester cord can provide strength and consistent color; cotton feels natural but can absorb moisture; waxed cord changes feel and knot behavior; elastic is convenient for bracelets but requires stretch-life testing. Metal-linked rosaries depend on wire gauge, eye-pin closure, jump-ring construction, chain material, and plating quality. Ask for pull testing or repeat-use testing when the application demands it.
entries.translation: Ang tibay ay nakasalalay din sa kung paano binuo ang rosaryo. Ang nylon at polyester cord ay maaaring magbigay ng lakas at pare-parehong kulay; ang cotton ay natural ngunit maaaring sumipsip ng kahalumigmigan; ang waxed cord ay nagbabago ng pakiramdam at pag-uugali ng buhol; ang elastic ay maginhawa para sa mga bracelet ngunit nangangailangan ng stretch-life testing. Ang mga metal-linked na rosaryo ay nakasalalay sa wire gauge, eye-pin closure, jump-ring construction, chain material, at plating quality. Humingi ng pull testing o repeat-use testing kapag hinihingi ito ng aplikasyon.

entries.source: These names describe different material families and should not be treated as interchangeable. Acrylic and other molded plastics are useful for lightweight, colorful, price-sensitive programs. Resin can support embedded images, handcrafted effects, and complex shapes. Soft PVC and silicone are used for flexible charms and children-oriented designs. Confirm the exact polymer, hardness, odor, colorfastness, molding marks, and destination-market requirements.
entries.translation: Ang mga pangalang ito ay naglalarawan ng iba't ibang pamilya ng materyal at hindi dapat ituring na magkapalit. Ang acrylic at iba pang molded plastics ay kapaki-pakinabang para sa magaan, makulay, at sensitibo sa presyo na mga programa. Ang resin ay maaaring suportahan ang mga naka-embed na imahe, handcrafted effects, at kumplikadong hugis. Ang soft PVC at silicone ay ginagamit para sa flexible charms at mga disenyo para sa mga bata. Kumpirmahin ang eksaktong polymer, tigas, amoy, colorfastness, molding marks, at mga kinakailangan ng destinasyong merkado.

entries.source: Wood is lightweight, warm to the touch, and well suited to traditional, missionary, men's, and natural-style collections. entries.source: On a rosary programme, the packaging is usually the easiest part to brand. Typical options include a printed logo on a pouch or box, a branded insert card, a hangtag, a barcode label, and private-label information that replaces the supplier name. The product itself can also be customized through bead material, colour, size, pendant style and centerpiece, but those changes affect tooling and minimum quantities far more than a printed card does.
entries.translation: Sa isang programa ng rosaryo, ang packaging ang karaniwang pinakamadaling lagyan ng brand. Kabilang sa mga karaniwang opsyon ang naka-print na logo sa pouch o kahon, may brand na insert card, hangtag, barcode label, at impormasyon ng private label na pumapalit sa pangalan ng supplier. Maaari ring i-customize ang produkto mismo sa pamamagitan ng materyal ng butil, kulay, sukat, istilo ng pendant at centerpiece, ngunit mas malaki ang epekto ng mga pagbabagong ito sa tooling at minimum na dami kaysa sa isang naka-print na card.

entries.source: A stock OPP bag or a plain pouch can usually be added to a normal production or stock order. A printed box is a different kind of purchase: it needs artwork, a dieline, a printing run and often a minimum quantity per design. That minimum applies to the packaging, not necessarily to the rosary, so buyers sometimes discover that the box costs more to set up than the product inside it.

Naaangkop ang minimum na iyon sa packaging, hindi laging sa rosaryo, kaya minsan natutuklasan ng mga mamimili na mas mahal ang setup ng kahon kaysa sa produktong nasa loob nito.
